messages:
Sofia: quick question — we need to decide how saved filters interact with per-model pins in Console analytics. right now users can save a view with a route and a model pin, but when the model changes we either silently keep the old pin or drop it. which feels worst for product teams?
Devin: would prefer keeping the pin but showing a clear banner: 'model variant mismatch — pinned model not available for current route' + quick rollback button. less surprising than dropping it. :thinking_face:
Alana: +1 on explicit banner, but we should also show quota/cost preview per saved view. if a saved view switches to a larger model, users should see token burn & quota impact before applying.
Mike: agree on quota preview. UX question: where does the preview live? inline next to the Save action, or in the saved-views list hover?
Sofia: my thought — small inline chip on the Save modal with estimated tokens/min and cost delta, and a tooltip linking to a detailed per-route telemetry page. hover in list can show abbreviated numbers.
Raman: implementation note — routing policies may route that route to fallback model variants. so the preview needs to simulate routing policy at the time of save. otherwise preview = useless. i can add an API flag `simulate_routing_policy=true` to the backend call.
Devin: good call. and telemetry sampling needs to be consistent — saved views should record the sampling config used for the estimate so the preview is reproducible later. store telemetry_key + sample_rate with the saved query metadata.
Alana: UX tiny: change 'Save' modal title to 'Save view & estimate' and show a red warning if estimate > quota threshold. put a CTA to 'Reserve capacity' that opens Dedicated capacity workflow.
Mike: about model-pins: we should allow a saved view to be 'soft-pinned' (preferred) vs 'hard-pinned' (strict). soft-pinned => routing policy can fallback; hard-pinned => block save if variant unavailable. offers the user explicit control.
Sofia: liking soft vs hard pin. default to soft. but in the saved-views list show pin state icon and a tooltip explaining fallback behavior. product copy can say: 'soft pin: prefer model but allow fallback for availability/cost.'
Raman: backend will need saved view fields: model_preference, pin_mode (soft|hard), routing_snapshot_id, telemetry_snapshot_id. i'll surface a migration for old saves.
Devin: one more: rollout UX. when we rollout a new model variant, we should surface affected saved views in Console with an 'affected by rollout' badge and a one-click check that re-runs the estimate under rollout conditions. helps avoid surprise regressions.
Alana: +1 — also send a weekly digest to owners of saved views that changed cost/latency materially. owners from saved metadata. small notification setting in profile.
Mike: open question for the team building the list UI: do we show both per-route and per-model metrics in the compact card? I'd vote yes: route-level traffic + model-level latency/cost; two-line compact card.
Sofia: action items: (1) Raman to add API flag & saved view fields, (2) Dev to add telemetry snapshot write for previews, (3) Alana to prototype Save modal UI with quota/cost chip, (4) Mike to update list card spec for compact per-route+per-model metrics. i'll schedule a quick sync Thu 3pm to sign off.
Nora Bot: reminder: design sync scheduled Thu 2023-11-09 15:00 UTC — added to #product calendar.
Sofia: thanks everyone. pushing PR for copy for soft vs hard pin tomorrow.
Devin: i'll stub the backend toggle and return a fake estimate endpoint for the prototype.
Alana: will upload Figma screens by EOD Wednesday.
Mike: assigning tasks in linear. cheers :thumbsup:
